powerpagecomponent.content:
{
  "source": "{% comment %}
  The grade a case currently stands on, as words (BR-005, BR-007, PP-17).

  Include with the two al_outcome columns, final first:
    (% capture grade %)(% include 'OT Outcome Label' final: row['oc.al_finaloutcome'] initial: row['oc.al_initialoutcome'] %)(% endcapture %)
    (% assign grade = grade | strip %)

  BR-007 keeps the initial and final outcomes in separate columns so both survive a
  regrade, so every reader has to answer the same question: final where one has been
  recorded, otherwise initial. That precedence is written once, here, rather than at each
  call site where getting it backwards would show a superseded grade. It is the same rule
  the plug-ins apply in Outcomes.EffectiveOutcome and the Code App applies in
  caseWorklistMapping.

  Output is a label or nothing. Never an option-set number: an operational screen showing
  "120910711" where a grade belongs is unreadable, and the reader has no way to look it up
  (the design skill's rule against exposing Dataverse internals). A row this cannot resolve
  yields empty, and the caller renders its own "not yet graded" state rather than a number.

  Component id, and why it is not the obvious one. Web templates and page templates are
  both rows of powerpagecomponent under the enhanced data model, so they share one id
  space. This template was first minted on a1000000-...-0022, which the environment was
  already using for the OT Case Detail Page *page template*. The id was taken, so every
  upload left this template uncreated while reporting success elsewhere, and /cases
  rendered "Template 'OT Outcome Label' not found" in its outcome column. It now sits on
  a1000000-...-001e, inside the web-template block, clear of the page templates at 0020
  and above. Do not move it back onto a page template's id.

  .label is used where the platform supplies it. The numeric map is the fallback for the
  reads where it does not come through - an aliased column from a link-entity does not
  always carry its formatted value - and it is the reason this file exists as one include
  instead of a repeated inline expression.
{% endcomment %}
{% assign grade = final | default: initial %}
{% if grade %}{% assign text = grade.label %}{% if text and text != '' %}{{ text }}{% else %}{% assign raw = grade.value | default: grade | integer %}{% case raw %}
{% when 120910700 %}Pass
{% when 120910701 %}Pass with issues
{% when 120910702 %}Insufficient evidence
{% when 120910703 %}Potential harm
{% when 120910710 %}Pass
{% when 120910711 %}Pass with issues
{% when 120910712 %}Insufficient evidence
{% when 120910713 %}Potential harm
{% endcase %}{% endif %}{% endif %}
"
}
powerpagecomponent.name: OT Outcome Label
